gtcsolo.gas_generator.support_requiremen: Speed upgrades require a combustion support material
gtcsolo.gas_generator.introduction.1: Burns supported gaseous and fluid fuels to generate power. A turbine rotor is required; its material affects fuel throughput, efficiency, and durability.
gtcsolo.gas_generator.introduction.2: The existing gas and fluid tanks can hold fluid fuel with gaseous support, or gaseous fuel with fluid support. A tank cannot hold fuel and support together. Gas fuel takes priority when both tanks contain fuel. Support materials alone generate no power.
gtcsolo.gas_generator.introduction.3: Speed upgrades increase fuel consumption and generation speed up to 10 times. Insufficient support supply limits the speed bonus; without support, the generator runs at normal speed.
gtcsolo.gas_generator.introduction.4: Rotor power affects fuel throughput, while rotor efficiency affects energy produced per unit of fuel. The machine's 48%% base generation is multiplied by rotor efficiency. Rotors wear during operation; a broken rotor stops combustion. Stopped generators cause no wear.
gtcsolo.gas_generator.introduction.5: Each energy upgrade multiplies storage by √3 without changing fuel efficiency. Falling fuel levels reduce generation speed. Maintain fuel and support supplies, sufficient power extraction, and enough energy storage for upgraded operation.
gtcsolo.gas_generator.introduction.6:
§lCombustion Support§r
Support is consumed according to total energy generated during boosted operation. Normal-speed, full-buffer, and stopped operation consume none; fractional credit is saved. Oxygen requires a much larger supply than the mixed gas. Currently registered supports are listed below.

No combustion support materials are currently registered.
